Report changes that lower a config's credit spend

## Usage

`circleci config optimize [<path>] [flags]`

## Arguments

`<path>` is the config, by default `.circleci/config.yml`; `-` reads stdin.

## Flags

| Flag                           | Description                                                                                  |
| ------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--credit-rates string`        | credits per minute per class (YAML file; default built-in gen1)                              |
| `-f, --force`                  | overwrite the -o file, or skip the clean-worktree check                                      |
| `--in-place`                   | replace <path>; needs a clean git worktree                                                   |
| `--jq string`                  | Process values from the response using jq syntax (see `circleci help formatting`)            |
| `--json`                       | Output as JSON                                                                               |
| `--only strings`               | checks to run: resource-class (default all)                                                  |
| `--org string`                 | Organization slug (e.g. gh/myorg) or UUID for private orb resolution; defaults to git remote |
| `-o, --output string`          | write the optimized config to this file (- for stdout)                                       |
| `--pipeline-parameters string` | pipeline parameters as a YAML map or path to a YAML file                                     |
| `--usage string`               | per-job CPU and memory usage (JSON file), for resource classes                               |
| `-v, --verbose`                | also list report-only findings, with evidence                                                |

Global flags: `-c, --config`, `--debug`, `--no-color`, `-q, --quiet` — see `circleci --help`.

## Examples

- Report what could change, sizing classes from usage: 
  `circleci config optimize --usage usage.json`
- Write the optimized config, sizing classes from usage: 
  `circleci config optimize --usage usage.json -o optimized.yml`
- The report as JSON: 
  `circleci config optimize --usage usage.json --json`

## Details

Find cheaper resource classes from per-job usage. JSON fields: schema_version, command, summary.result, findings[].id
